title: Fanout of a vertex in a gate list
statement: For a list of directed acyclic graph gates and a natural-number vertex $v$, define the fanout of $v$ to be the number of gates in the list whose argument list contains $v$. Each such gate is counted once, even if $v$ occurs more than once among its arguments.
